conceptZh: 科學家老鼠輕輕推倒一塊骨牌，彩色試管連鎖倒下，剛好排成「時」。
object: a bespectacled lab mouse with a line of dominoes made of colorful test tubes
morph: a domino chain of fizzing tubes tumbles and lands as the strokes of 時
creativeAngle: 骨牌連鎖加上準時的鬧鐘，聲音和畫面同步。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale lilac background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 時 as the only text on screen, drawn in emerald green solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a round-eyed lab mouse in a white coat and thick glasses pokes the first test-tube domino with a pencil while a beaker fizzes over on cue; the first 時 is spoken as the sun-shaped left 日 tube tips and lands upright. 1.7-3.4s: the chain rattles across a lab bench, a wobbling beaker hiccups bubbles, one tube spins in place before falling; second 時 as the 土 and 寸 tubes click down beside the 日. 3.4-5s: 準時 is spoken as a toy alarm clock at the end of the chain rings exactly when the last tube lands, the mouse's glasses sliding down in surprise, then pushing them back up. 5-8s: hold; the glyph rests still while the mouse takes a bow and a bubble floats up. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "時、時、準時" (ㄕˊ、ㄕˊ、ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄕˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 時 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
